author: CristPasache
description:
CVC-ClinicDB (file mirror)
	

612 frames extracted from 29 colonoscopy sequences, each with a pixel-level
polyp mask (Bernal et al., 2015). Native resolution 384x288.
This is a plain file mirror, not a datasets-format repo: images and masks
are stored as files so any path-based dataloader can consume them directly
after snapshot_download. The dataset viewer is disabled for that reason.

CVC-ClinicDB/

author: JuneYao
description:
medical-jev-4b 训练数据
	

medical-jev-4b 使用的医疗决策选择题：从约 77 个公开来源整理为 27 类决策任务的统一格式。

	
		
文件
题数
用途


		
train.jsonl
242,921
训练池；实际训练按配置抽样（每类任务最多 3,000 题，通用医学题 10,000 题）


development.jsonl
1,566
选模用开发集，每类 60 题（分诊 6 题）


development_v1_heldout.jsonl
1,151
开发集中 v1 未训练过的子集，用于和 v1 公平比较


test.jsonl
1,557
留出测试，每类约 60 题


	


	
		
	
	
		重要说明
	


这不是 v1 当时的逐条训练数据。 v1 使用的原始训练文件已丢失；这里是随后用本地保留的上游版本和各轮补充重建的训练池，各任务规模与 v1 训练池基本一致。
test.jsonl 对用本训练池训练的模型是干净的留出集；但 v1 的训练池包含其上游来源，对 v1 不是盲测。… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/JuneYao/medical-jev-4b-data.

author: KeremTT
description:
CMMD Mammography
	

Digital mammograms in DICOM format from the Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD), repackaged with per-breast benign / malignant labels and patient-level train / validation / test splits.

	
		
	
	
		Contents
	


data/cmmd_*.zip: DICOM files, one ZIP per batch of patients. Inside each ZIP, files are stored as <split>/<label>/<patient>_<file>.dcm.
